اعتزمتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمَتَا (iʕtazamatā) /iʕ.ta.za.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمَتَا (uʕtuzimatā) /uʕ.tu.zi.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
